choice_data_list: I'm counting on you next time!

Sorry, Trainer-chan. I couldn't
show you how cool I can be...
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you next time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...All right, then I gotta get back at Mach speed
and train!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "I really want to show them what I've got next time! Fufu♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Moping around isn't going to make me any faster.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So no staying down in the dumps! I've gotta take after
Tacchan, who gets fixed right up even when he gets dented!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it for my repairs!
Time to gas up quick and zoom off!
